description: Send ops of gripforge.debug/1 to the debug inspector of a game open in a browser by a member of its workspace, then read the snapshot: { op: "mode", wireframe?, colliders?, bounds? } (wireframe, collision boxes, mesh bounds), { op: "tree", root?, depth?, maxNodes? }, { op: "select", ids }, { op: "hide", id, hidden }, { op: "outline", id, on }, { op: "reset" } (show everything, no outline), { op: "extension", id, on } (a debug mode of a kit, e.g. ai.navigation.paths), { op: "open" } / { op: "close" } (the panel on screen). Ids are those of the snapshot tree. Nothing is saved in the project. Same rights as the panel: members of the workspace. 0 credits.

ops.description: One op or a list of ops.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

session_id.description: A play session (play-…) of gripforge_runtime_sessions; default: the latest play page of the project.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the page to answer (default 8); 0 answers at once with status received.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_debug_set
title: Drive the debug inspector of a running game
